description: This Java class, AbstractFieldBsonCreator, serves as a base class for constructing MongoDB BSON filter objects based on expression visitors. It provides methods for creating global read filters, handling authorization, and visiting different path types within some expression evaluation context.

classes.name: AbstractFieldBsonCreator
classes.description: An abstract class used as a base for creating BSON filters from expression visitors, particularly in the context of authorization and resource access filtering.

methods.name: getGlobalReadBson
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for global read access based on a list of authorization subject IDs.

methods.name: visitPointer
methods.description: Abstract method to generate a BSON filter based on a pointer string within the expression context.

methods.name: visitRootLevelField
methods.description: Abstract method to generate a BSON filter for a root level field.

methods.name: getAuthorizationBson
methods.description: Generates an optional BSON filter based on authorization subject IDs, incorporating granted and revoked filters.

methods.name: visitAcl
methods.description: Deprecated method that throws an exception indicating ACL expressions are unsupported.

methods.name: visitGlobalReads
methods.description: Deprecated method that throws an exception indicating global read expressions are unsupported.

methods.name: visitSimple
methods.description: Determines whether to visit a pointer or root level field based on the field name's starting character.
